limitations: Neutral engine support only. Target-version lighting, tint, overlay and arbitrary fractional-alpha material parity remain unverified. Colour masking follows USE_COLOR_MASK and three-sampler draws follow USE_MULTITEXTURE; the native sheep and wolf bases declare the first and llama the second. Sheep dye callbacks and independent server-pack sampler overrides remain incomplete. Installed material/shader evidence is near-version, not an exact target-binary witness.

color_mask_reference.contract: USE_COLOR_MASK interpolates the RGB dye multiplier by raster alpha. No alpha test or blending; alpha is a color mask, not opacity. Near-version installed vanilla runtime witness.

multitexture_reference.contract: USE_MULTITEXTURE samples three textures on the same normalized UV. RGB first interpolates base toward texture1 by texture1 alpha, then toward texture2 by texture2 alpha; base alpha is retained. Llama has no ALPHA_TEST, COLOR_SECOND_TEXTURE or blending. Near-version installed runtime witness.
